Create Atlantis Model Calibration Settings

make_calsettings.Rd

Generates a calibration settings file for functional groups in an Atlantis model. Creates a dataframe specifying which groups to calibrate, their associated variables, calibration weights, and data file paths.

Only groups with IsCalibrated == 1 and IsTurnedOn == 1 in the parameter table are calibrated. For each target type in var.type, a separate calibration settings file and corresponding target files are created (see create_target_files_biomass, create_target_files_waa, create_target_files_abund and create_target_files_catch).

Usage

make_calsettings(
  fg.file,
  var.type,
  fun.type,
  dt.timeseries,
  w.vector,
  biology.prm,
  biom.indx,
  init.file,
  catch.file,
  run.prm,
  parameter.file = "parameter_table.csv"
)

Arguments

fg.file

Character. Name of the functional group configuration file (CSV) located in inputs/model_configuration/. Must contain the columns Code, Name, IsTurnedOn, and NumCohorts.

var.type

Character vector. Target types to calibrate: any of "biomass", "weight", "abundance" and "catch".

fun.type

Character. Calibrar package optimization function for calibration

dt.timeseries

Integer. Number of time steps in each target time series.

w.vector

Data frame. Optional custom weights with columns "Code" and "weight_new" to override default weights. If NULL, default weights are used.

biology.prm

Character. Name of the Atlantis biology parameter file in inputs/model_configuration/.

biom.indx

Character. Name of the Atlantis biomass index output file (<prefix>_OUTBiomIndx.txt), used to create biomass targets.

init.file

Character. Name of the Atlantis initial conditions NetCDF file, used to create weight-at-age and abundance targets.

catch.file

Character. Name of the observed catch CSV file, used to create catch targets.

run.prm

Character. Name of the Atlantis run parameter file in inputs/model_configuration/. The tstop parameter will be set to dt.timeseries.

parameter.file

Character. Name of the parameter table CSV file in inputs/, with one row per functional group and one column per parameter to calibrate, set to 1 if the parameter is calibrated for that group (see create_target_files_biomass). Default: "parameter_table.csv".

Value

Invisibly returns NULL. Writes one calibration settings CSV file for each target type (e.g., calibration_settings_biomass.csv, calibration_settings_weight.csv) to inputs/.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
make_calsettings(fg.file       = "SETasGroupsDem.csv",
                 var.type      = c("biomass", "weight"),
                 fun.type      = "lnorm2",
                 dt.timeseries = 5,
                 w.vector      = NULL,
                 biology.prm   = "VMPA_setas_biol_fishing_Trunk.prm",
                 biom.indx     = "outputSETASBiomIndx.txt",
                 init.file     = "INIT_VMPA_Jan2015.nc",
                 catch.file    = "catch_timeseries.csv",
                 parameter.file = "parameter_table.csv")
} # }
